scope: A800 preflight attempts for full-film named-flower and robot-hand instance tracking
summary: Several bounded launch attempts failed before useful tracking work; every failed path was preserved and corrected with a new output directory rather than overwritten.
evidence: The first transfer attempted to target a missing remote parent and wrote no valid experiment.

The first SAM2 launch named a nonexistent standalone checkpoint path and failed with FileNotFoundError; the verified checkpoint is checkpoints/Wan2.2-Animate-14B/process_checkpoint/sam2/sam2_hiera_large.pt.
Two shell-background/log-directory attempts failed before GPU inference because their output/log paths were constructed incorrectly.

candidate-hand-tracks-0254-v3 failed before GPU inference because the launcher pre-created the experiment directory and the tracker correctly refused to overwrite it; the retry uses candidate-hand-tracks-0254-v4.
lessons: Tracker output directories must not exist before launch; controller logs belong in a sibling log directory.
Checkpoint existence and destination-parent creation are mandatory preflight checks before allocating a GPU.
limitations: These failed launches contain no tracking-quality evidence and do not supersede any successful or partial track result.
next_actions: Keep using unique experiment directories, the verified bundled SAM2 checkpoint, physical-GPU validation, and sibling controller logs.
